data.name: Hollowmere
data.description: A lakeside town of crooked roofs and a hundred lamp posts, fewer lit each week.

data.name: The Drowned Lantern
data.description: Hollowmere's inn, half sunk into the lake shore. The ale is warm and the gossip is warmer.

data.name: Lantern of Kindled Paths
data.description: While lit, it shows footprints left in the last day as faint embers.

data.name: Cinder Key
data.description: A brass key still warm to the touch. It opens the toll house on Cinder Bridge, and one door nobody has found.

data.name: Ashen Cloak
data.description: Grey wool that sheds soot instead of taking it. The wearer leaves no footprints in ash.

data.name: Morrow's Ledger
data.description: The reeve's book of lamp oil deliveries. The last nine entries are in a hand that is not hers.

data.name: Wick Cutter
data.description: A lamplighter's hooked knife. Wren keeps it sharper than any lamplighter needs.

data.name: Wand of Kindling
data.description: A charred rowan wand. Speak its word and a lamp, a torch or a hearth in sight catches flame.

data.name: Fogbreaker Draught
data.description: Pale and bitter. For an hour the fog parts ten feet around whoever drinks it, and nothing in it sees them coming.

data.name: The Sunken Bell
data.description: A drowned abbey rings its bell at low tide, and everyone who hears it dreams of the same door.

data.name: Low Tide
data.description: Brann wades out to the abbey and hears the bell.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bs1a","kind":"paragraph","text":"The tide went out further than anyone in Saltmarsh remembers, and the abbey's bell tower stood clear of the water for the first time in forty years.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Who Rings the Bell
data.description: Someone climbs the drowned tower and rings the bell at every low tide, though no one has been seen going up.

data.name: Mother Quill
data.description: Chair of Salt, keeper of the market, mother of a drowned son.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-mother-quill-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"She sells nothing and buys secrets. Her son went to the Third Sluice on the night the choir sang his name, and did not come back.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-mother-quill-1","kind":"quote","text":"\"I will tell you what you want to know. You will tell me what I want to forget.\"","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-mother-quill-2","kind":"callout","text":"Owes the party nothing. Likes them anyway.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Warden Ilse Marrow
data.description: The child the sluice gave back, grown into the woman who holds its keys.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-warden-marrow-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Marrow does not speak of the Night of Lanterns and does not permit it to be spoken of in her hearing. She keeps the nine keys on a chain she never removes.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-warden-marrow-1","kind":"bullet","text":"Fair, hard, and sleepless at the spring tide.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-warden-marrow-2","kind":"bullet","text":"Hums the choir's song without knowing she does it.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Table notes, the bell arc
data.description: The DM's running thread.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-session-notes-0","kind":"todo","text":"Decide whether the tenth gate opens inward or outward.","options":{"done":true}},{"id":"bell-lore-session-notes-1","kind":"todo","text":"Seed the glassblower at the Lantern Market before session four.","options":{"done":false}},{"id":"bell-lore-session-notes-2","kind":"todo","text":"Let Wren find the junior guildsman's lost key.","options":{"done":false}},{"id":"bell-lore-session-notes-3","kind":"divider","text":"","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-session-notes-4","kind":"paragraph","text":"The bell rings a third time at the end of the arc, whatever the party does. The question is who is standing in the tower when it does.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The roads of Hollowmere
data.description: Every road out of town and what waits on it.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-roads-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Hollowmere has four roads and keeps three of them lit.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The Ember Road
data.description: The north road, lit by lamps that burn without oil.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-ember-road-0","kind":"heading","text":"The road","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"ember-lore-ember-road-1","kind":"paragraph","text":"Forty lamp posts from the town gate to Cinder Bridge. Each burns an ember that needs no oil and gives no heat. The lamplighters tend them anyway.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-ember-road-2","kind":"bullet","text":"Lamps 1 to 12: the town stretch, never dark.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-ember-road-3","kind":"bullet","text":"Lamps 13 to 31: the moor stretch, where the fog comes in.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-ember-road-4","kind":"bullet","text":"Lamps 32 to 40: the bridge stretch, held by the ash-cloaks.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-ember-road-5","kind":"callout","text":"Five lamplighters vanished on the moor stretch this month.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Cinder Bridge
data.description: The toll nobody should have asked for.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-cinder-bridge-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"A stone span over the Ash, held by bandits in grey cloaks who demanded lamp oil as toll. The company paid, then took it back.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-cinder-bridge-1","kind":"quote","text":"\"Oil, not coin. Coin does not burn.\"","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-cinder-bridge-2","kind":"todo","text":"Find out who buys the oil from the ash-cloaks.","options":{"done":false}}]}

data.name: The Salt Road
data.description: South to the coast. Unlit, and safer for it.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-salt-road-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"The one road Hollowmere never lit. Carters prefer it. The fog does not follow it.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-salt-road-1","kind":"bullet","text":"Two days to the coast by cart.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-salt-road-2","kind":"bullet","text":"The Drowned Lantern's barrels come up this road.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The fog from the east
data.description: It comes with the disappearances, and leaves with them.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-the-fog-0","kind":"heading","text":"Observed","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"ember-lore-the-fog-1","kind":"number","text":"It comes in on the nights a lamplighter vanishes.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-the-fog-2","kind":"number","text":"It stops at lamp 12, every time.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-the-fog-3","kind":"number","text":"Lamps it touches burn blue until dawn.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-the-fog-4","kind":"divider","text":"","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-the-fog-5","kind":"callout","text":"The fog is not weather. Reeve Morrow knows this and has not said it aloud.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The Lamplighters' Lodge
data.description: Nine lamplighters, five missing, four who will not walk the moor stretch.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-lamplighters-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"The lodge tends the forty lamps on a rota older than the reeve's office. It has lost five of its nine this month and kept the other four indoors.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-lamplighters-1","kind":"bullet","text":"Lodge-master Tam Reedy speaks for them.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-lamplighters-2","kind":"bullet","text":"The lodge book records every lamp lit and every lamp found dark.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-lamplighters-3","kind":"quote","text":"\"We light them. We do not ask what they are for.\"","options":{}}]}

data.name: Reeve Halda Morrow
data.description: Hired the company, pays on time, lies about the fog.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-reeve-morrow-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Morrow has governed Hollowmere for eleven years and lit every lamp on the Ember Road herself at least once. She hired the company at the Drowned Lantern and paid half in advance.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-reeve-morrow-1","kind":"callout","text":"She knows what the fog is. She will not say until the party can prove it.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-reeve-morrow-2","kind":"todo","text":"Press her after the lodge book is read.","options":{"done":false}}]}

data.name: The Drowned Lantern
data.description: The inn where the company met, and where it still sleeps.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-drowned-lantern-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"A coaching inn at lamp 1, named for a lantern that hangs in the common room and has never been lit.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-drowned-lantern-1","kind":"bullet","text":"Free lodging while the lamplighter matter stands.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-drowned-lantern-2","kind":"bullet","text":"The innkeeper waters the ale and knows every carter on the Salt Road.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The ash-cloaks
data.description: Bandits who want oil, not coin.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-ash-cloaks-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Grey-cloaked, soft-spoken, and gone into the moor fog the moment the company pushed back at Cinder Bridge.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-ash-cloaks-1","kind":"heading","text":"What is known","options":{"level":3}},{"id":"ember-lore-ash-cloaks-2","kind":"bullet","text":"They carry a map of every lamp post in Hollowmere.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-ash-cloaks-3","kind":"bullet","text":"They burn oil in open pans on the bridge, for no reason the company could see.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-ash-cloaks-4","kind":"callout","text":"The pans burned blue.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The lodge book
data.description: Forty lamps, a hundred years, every dark night recorded.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-lodge-book-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"The book lists every lamp found dark and the lamplighter who relit it. The five missing lamplighters relit the same lamp, lamp 23, in the week before each vanished.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-lodge-book-1","kind":"callout","text":"Lamp 23 is the one the fog reaches first.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-lodge-book-2","kind":"todo","text":"Stand watch at lamp 23 on the next fog night.","options":{"done":false}}]}

data.name: Rumours on the Ember Road
data.description: What the carters say.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-rumours-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Carters talk. Most of it is about ale.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Blue lamps mean a death
data.description: An old carter's rule, and lately a reliable one.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-rumour-blue-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Every carter on the Salt Road knows it: a lamp that burns blue on the Ember Road means someone is not coming home.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-rumour-blue-1","kind":"quote","text":"\"Forty lamps. Count the blue ones and you have counted the dead.\"","options":{}}]}

data.name: The reeve lit lamp 23 herself
data.description: The night before the first lamplighter vanished.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-rumour-reeve-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"The lodge book has a page torn out. Tam Reedy says the reeve took it. The reeve says the lodge book is not her concern.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The oil goes east
data.description: Nobody east of Hollowmere needs lamp oil.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-rumour-oil-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"The ash-cloaks' oil leaves Cinder Bridge on a cart that heads into the moor, where there is no road and no town.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-rumour-oil-1","kind":"todo","text":"Follow the cart.","options":{"done":false}}]}

data.name: The Hollow Moor
data.description: East of the lamps. Where the fog comes from.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-moor-0","kind":"heading","text":"The moor","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"ember-lore-moor-1","kind":"paragraph","text":"Unlit, unmapped, and avoided. The fog rises from it on no schedule anyone has found, and goes back into it before dawn.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-moor-2","kind":"bullet","text":"No lamp post has ever stood east of lamp 40.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-moor-3","kind":"bullet","text":"The ash-cloaks' cart goes in. Nobody has seen it come out.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-moor-4","kind":"callout","text":"Something out there wants the lamps lit. Something else wants them dark.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Table notes, the Ember Road
data.description: The DM's running thread.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-dm-thread-0","kind":"todo","text":"Reveal that the embers are the missing lamplighters' lights, not fuel.","options":{"done":false}},{"id":"ember-lore-dm-thread-1","kind":"todo","text":"Let the party catch the oil cart before session five.","options":{"done":false}},{"id":"ember-lore-dm-thread-2","kind":"todo","text":"Reeve Morrow confesses when lamp 23 goes dark for good.","options":{"done":false}},{"id":"ember-lore-dm-thread-3","kind":"divider","text":"","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-dm-thread-4","kind":"paragraph","text":"The fog is the moor breathing in. The lamps are what it breathes out. Keep that for the last session.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Tides and bells
data.description: What the water does twice a day, and what the tower does about it.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-tides-0","kind":"heading","text":"Tides and bells","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"bell-lore-tides-1","kind":"paragraph","text":"The drowned quarter keeps time by the water, not the sun. Every page under this one is a piece of that clock.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-tides-2","kind":"bullet","text":"The tide table, as the Tidewardens post it.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-tides-3","kind":"bullet","text":"The nine bells and what each one is rung for.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-tides-4","kind":"bullet","text":"The low tide rite, which nobody admits to attending.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The tide table
data.description: Posted on the Third Sluice every new moon, and wrong about once a season.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-tide-table-0","kind":"heading","text":"The table","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"bell-lore-tide-table-1","kind":"number","text":"First low water an hour before dawn, the only time the archive stairs are dry.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-tide-table-2","kind":"number","text":"First high water at midmorning, when the Lantern Market floats its stalls.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-tide-table-3","kind":"number","text":"Second low water at dusk, when the bell is rung from below.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-tide-table-4","kind":"number","text":"Second high water past midnight, when the sluices are shut and the quarter is sealed.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-tide-table-5","kind":"callout","text":"A Tidewarden who posts a wrong table loses a copper key for it. Three wrong tables this year, and nobody has lost a key.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-tide-table-6","kind":"divider","text":"","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-tide-table-7","kind":"quote","text":"The water is never late. The table is.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The nine bells
data.description: The tower held nine before it drowned. Eight still answer.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-0","kind":"heading","text":"Eight that ring","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-1","kind":"bullet","text":"Matins, the smallest, rung for a birth.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-2","kind":"bullet","text":"Salt, rung when the Court sits.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-3","kind":"bullet","text":"Warden, rung when a sluice is opened by hand.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-4","kind":"bullet","text":"Choir, rung for a drowning, and said to ring itself.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-5","kind":"bullet","text":"Lantern, rung for market days.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-6","kind":"bullet","text":"Reeve, rung for a hanging, not rung in forty years.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-7","kind":"bullet","text":"Harrow, rung for fire on the water.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-8","kind":"bullet","text":"Vesper, rung at the second low water, by whoever climbs.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-9","kind":"heading","text":"One that does not","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"bell-lore-nine-bells-10","kind":"paragraph","text":"The ninth, the Great Bell, lost its clapper the night the quarter went under. The Guild says it was swept away. The Guild also keeps a locked room at the top of the tower.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The low tide rite
data.description: Something happens at the foot of the tower at the second low water, and the Court has made it illegal to say what.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-low-tide-rite-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"The party has seen it once, from the Lantern Market, through fog. A line of figures with their faces covered, walking down stairs that should have been underwater.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-low-tide-rite-1","kind":"todo","text":"Find out who keeps the stairs dry.","options":{"done":false}},{"id":"bell-lore-low-tide-rite-2","kind":"todo","text":"Follow one of them back up before the water turns.","options":{"done":false}},{"id":"bell-lore-low-tide-rite-3","kind":"todo","text":"Ask Warden Marrow why the Tidewardens look the other way.","options":{"done":false}},{"id":"bell-lore-low-tide-rite-4","kind":"todo","text":"Learn the hour from the tide table.","options":{"done":true}},{"id":"bell-lore-low-tide-rite-5","kind":"callout","text":"A seated player who attends the rite in person should expect a hidden roll from the DM.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Songs of the Choir
data.description: The Drowned Choir sings in a tongue the Salt Court pretends is nonsense.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-songs-0","kind":"heading","text":"Songs","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"bell-lore-songs-1","kind":"paragraph","text":"What follows was written down by Seraphine from memory, after three nights of listening at the waterline. She is not sure of every word.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Undertow
data.description: The song the Choir sings as the water drops.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-song-undertow-0","kind":"quote","text":"Down, down, where the bell went down,","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-song-undertow-1","kind":"quote","text":"Down where the lamps are lit and drowned,","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-song-undertow-2","kind":"quote","text":"Down where the Court has never sat,","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-song-undertow-3","kind":"quote","text":"Down where the clapper swings, and that","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-song-undertow-4","kind":"quote","text":"Is where we go, and that is where we stay.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-song-undertow-5","kind":"paragraph","text":"Seraphine notes that the last line changes each night. On the third night it was sung as \"and that is where you stay.\"","options":{}}]}

data.name: The clapper's lullaby
data.description: Heard only once, hummed by a child in the Lantern Market who could not say where she learned it.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-song-clapper-0","kind":"quote","text":"Hush, the Guild has got the tongue,","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-song-clapper-1","kind":"quote","text":"Hush, the bell will not be rung,","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-song-clapper-2","kind":"quote","text":"Hush, the ninth is only sleeping,","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-song-clapper-3","kind":"quote","text":"Hush, the Choir has it keeping.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-song-clapper-4","kind":"callout","text":"If the Guild has the clapper, this is the second source for it after the rumour on the roll.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Brother Oss
data.description: A thin man in a wet cassock who sells candles in the Lantern Market and never seems to light one.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-brother-oss-0","kind":"heading","text":"What Pip knows","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"bell-lore-brother-oss-1","kind":"bullet","text":"He knew Pip's name before Pip said it.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-brother-oss-2","kind":"bullet","text":"He hums while he counts coin. Seraphine says it is Undertow.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-brother-oss-3","kind":"bullet","text":"His candles do not gutter in the fog.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-brother-oss-4","kind":"heading","text":"What Pip suspects","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"bell-lore-brother-oss-5","kind":"paragraph","text":"He is the Choir's man above the waterline, and he is selling candles to see who buys light before the second low water.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-brother-oss-6","kind":"todo","text":"Buy a candle and see whether it burns blue.","options":{"done":false}}]}

data.name: The salt lanes
data.description: The dry alleys behind the Lantern Market where the Court's clerks live, named for the salt crust on every step.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-salt-lanes-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Nothing floats here. The lanes were built a storey above the old quarter after the flood, on the rubble of what drowned, and the Court made sure the stairs down were bricked over.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-salt-lanes-1","kind":"callout","text":"Pip found one that was not. It is behind the candle stall.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-salt-lanes-2","kind":"divider","text":"","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-salt-lanes-3","kind":"bullet","text":"Clerks' row, where the Court's paper is kept.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-salt-lanes-4","kind":"bullet","text":"The bricked stairs, four of them, each with a Court seal.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-salt-lanes-5","kind":"bullet","text":"The fifth stair, unsealed, behind Brother Oss.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The Bellringers' ledger
data.description: The Guild's book of who rang what and when. The DM keeps the real one; the party has seen three pages.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-ledger-0","kind":"toggle","text":"The three pages the party copied","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-ledger-1","kind":"bullet","text":"Vesper rung by \"the usual hand\" every night for eleven years. No name.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-ledger-2","kind":"bullet","text":"Choir rung on the night of lanterns, by order of the Court. The order is pasted in and the seal is the seventh chair's.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-ledger-3","kind":"bullet","text":"A payment of forty salt marks to \"O.\" for candles, monthly, since the flood.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-ledger-4","kind":"divider","text":"","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-ledger-5","kind":"heading","text":"What the ledger does not say","options":{"level":3}},{"id":"bell-lore-ledger-6","kind":"paragraph","text":"Who climbs the tower at dusk. Every other bell has a name against it.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-ledger-7","kind":"todo","text":"Steal a fourth page.","options":{"done":false}}]}

data.name: Pip's notes, the drowned quarter
data.description: Pip's own running page of the Sunken Bell, kept for Pip and shared with the table.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-pip-notes-0","kind":"heading","text":"Threads","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"bell-lore-pip-notes-1","kind":"number","text":"The candle man knows us.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-pip-notes-2","kind":"number","text":"The tide table is wrong on purpose.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-pip-notes-3","kind":"number","text":"Somebody rings Vesper, and the Guild writes down that it is nobody.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-pip-notes-4","kind":"number","text":"There is a stair behind the candle stall that goes down.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-pip-notes-5","kind":"heading","text":"Things I owe","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"bell-lore-pip-notes-6","kind":"todo","text":"Return Warden Marrow's lantern.","options":{"done":false}},{"id":"bell-lore-pip-notes-7","kind":"todo","text":"Pay the Court's clerk for the map of the lanes.","options":{"done":true}},{"id":"bell-lore-pip-notes-8","kind":"todo","text":"Tell Seraphine about the fifth stair before she finds it alone.","options":{"done":false}}]}

data.name: The Choir breathes for the city
data.description: Said in the Lantern Market: if the Choir ever stops singing, the water comes back up.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"bell-lore-rumour-choir-breath-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Half the market believes it. The other half pays Brother Oss for candles anyway.","options":{}},{"id":"bell-lore-rumour-choir-breath-1","kind":"quote","text":"You do not stop a bellows because you dislike the noise.","options":{}}]}

data.name: People of Hollowmere
data.description: Who the party has met on the road, and who the DM is keeping for later.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-people-0","kind":"heading","text":"People","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"ember-lore-people-1","kind":"paragraph","text":"Hollowmere is small enough that everyone knows the lamplighters by name. These are the names the party has.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-people-2","kind":"bullet","text":"Reeve Halda Morrow, who hired them.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-people-3","kind":"bullet","text":"Old Tamsin, the last lamplighter.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-people-4","kind":"bullet","text":"Brannock, who sells the oil.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-people-5","kind":"bullet","text":"Widow Fenn, who lost a son to lamp 23.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Brannock the oil-man
data.description: A broad, cheerful man with a cart of lamp oil and a ledger he does not let anyone read.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-brannock-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Brannock drives the Salt Road every tenth day and sells Hollowmere its lamp oil at a price nobody argues with. He has been doing it since before the reeve was reeve.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-brannock-1","kind":"heading","text":"What the party noticed","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"ember-lore-brannock-2","kind":"bullet","text":"The cart is heavier going east than coming west.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-brannock-3","kind":"bullet","text":"He pays the Lamplighters' Lodge, not the other way round.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-brannock-4","kind":"bullet","text":"He was in town the night of every disappearance.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-brannock-5","kind":"callout","text":"The DM has not confirmed any of this. The party is working from Tobrin's notes.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Widow Fenn
data.description: Her son lit lamp 23 for six years. She still sets a place for him and leaves the shutters open on fog nights.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-widow-fenn-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"She will talk to anyone who asks about her son, and she will not talk at all about the reeve.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-widow-fenn-1","kind":"quote","text":"He said the oil smelled wrong that week. He said it to the Lodge and they told him to light the lamp.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-widow-fenn-2","kind":"todo","text":"Ask her which week.","options":{"done":false}}]}

data.name: Old Tamsin
data.description: What Pip wrote down after an evening at the Drowned Lantern with Hollowmere's last lamplighter.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-old-tamsin-0","kind":"paragraph","text":"Tamsin has lit the eastern lamps for thirty years and has outlasted four other lamplighters this season alone. She says it is because she does not light lamp 23.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-old-tamsin-1","kind":"heading","text":"Her rules","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"ember-lore-old-tamsin-2","kind":"number","text":"Never light a lamp that is already warm.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-old-tamsin-3","kind":"number","text":"Never carry oil from Brannock's cart that smells of cinders.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-old-tamsin-4","kind":"number","text":"When the fog comes in from the east, put the lamp down and walk west without it.","options":{}},{"id":"ember-lore-old-tamsin-5","kind":"callout","text":"Pip thinks the third rule is the whole case.","options":{}}]}

data.name: The lamps
data.description: The twenty six lamps of the Ember Road, which ones burn, and which ones burn wrong.

fields.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ember-lore-lamps-0","kind":"heading","text":"The lamps","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"ember-lore-lamps-1","kind":"paragraph","text":"One lamp every two hundred paces from Cinder Bridge to the Hollowmere gate. The Lodge numbers them from the bridge. Everything the party has learned is filed under this one.","options":{}}]}

data.name: Lamp oil
data.description: What the lamps burn, where it comes from, and why it sometimes smells of cinders.

data.name: Adult Red Dragon

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: When the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (1d10 + 8) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, each creature in a 60-foot cone. Failure: 59 (17d6) fire damage. Success: half as much.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.text: The dragon moves up to half its speed and makes one Rend attack.

legendary_actions.name: Commanding Presence
legendary_actions.text: The dragon roars. Each creature of its choice within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

data.description:
A red dragon sleeps on its hoard in the heart of a smoking mountain and wakes to the smell of anyone who would take a single coin from it.

Its lair is a maze of lava tubes. While it is there, the ground shakes, vents spit fire and the air itself seems to burn.

data.name: Barrow Wight

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The wight makes two attacks, using Life Drain or Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's hit point maximum drops by the same amount until it finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

data.description: Wights keep the old barrows of the moor, still wearing the mail they were buried in. They remember the names of the kings they served and nothing else.

data.name: Giant Eagle

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.text: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The eagle makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

data.description: Giant eagles nest on the highest crags and keep old promises with the folk of the valleys. They will carry a rider who asks politely and drop one who does not.

data.name: Goblin Warrior

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.text: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

data.description: Goblins raid in packs that break and run the moment a fight turns, then come back at night for whatever was left behind.

data.name: Gelatinous Cube

traits.name: Transparent
traits.text: Even when the cube is in plain sight, spotting it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text: The cube moves up to its speed. Each creature it enters makes a DC 12 Dexterity save or is engulfed, taking 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns.

data.description: A gelatinous cube scours the corridors of old dungeons clean, leaving behind only the coins and buckles it cannot dissolve.

data.name: Gloom Cultist

traits.name: Mind Shroud
traits.text: The cultist cannot be read by magic that reads thoughts unless it allows it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The cultist makes two Tentacle Lash attacks and uses Mind Rot.

actions.name: Tentacle Lash
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Mind Rot
actions.text: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the cultist can see within 60 feet. Failure: 16 (3d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15). At will: mage hand, message. 1/day each: confusion, dimension door.

reactions.name: Warp Space
reactions.text: When a creature the cultist can see hits it with an attack, the cultist teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

data.description:
The cultists of the Hollow Choir listen to something beneath the city, and what it whispers has begun to change their bodies.

They are found in pairs, in cellars and in sewers, and they always know who is coming.

data.name: Cinder Imp

traits.name: Ember Trail
traits.text: The imp leaves glowing cinders where it walks. They burn out at the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Sting
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

data.description: Testy's own imp, half a joke and half a warning. It belongs to no campaign yet.

data.name: Mossback Toad

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The toad can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.text: The toad jumps up to 20 feet without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and a Medium or smaller target is grappled.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.text: The toad swallows a Small or smaller creature it is grappling.

data.description: Pip's homebrew. Moss grows on its back, and a whole fen of frogs follows it about.
